desc: 分体式铝合金执手，多层封釉镀层，孔距通用，握感静音
leaf: 室内门分体式铝合金门把手锁
name: 铝合金分体静音门把手款

shots.intent: 用低照度暗场与掠射侧光把镀层质感一次讲清，定调整个详情页。
shots.textZone: 顶部中央三分之一留白区：衬线大标题「{selling_point_1}」，其下一行细无衬线小字「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 合规白底主图，把分体式结构一次看清，负责搜索流量的一眼点击。
把旧把手掉漆、锈蚀、晃动的日常摩擦摆到眼前，制造替换动机。
shots.textZone: 顶部左上一行细无衬线小字「{callout_1}」，不写对比数据

shots.intent: 门体安装实景，让买家把自己家那扇门代入，确认装上后的比例与气质。
微距证明镀层与基材工艺，把质感疑虑一次消掉。
shots.textZone: 左侧留白：衬线标题「{selling_point_2}」，下一行小字「{callout_1}」

shots.intent: 用引线标签拆解镀层工序，解释为什么耐磨耐锈。
shots.textZone: 上方衬线标题「{selling_point_3}」；四枚圆角标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」「{callout_4}」以 1px 引线指向把手表面

shots.intent: 剖面分层对照加原材料圆窗，把结构差异变成看得见的证据。
shots.textZone: 两联各一行标签「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」，圆窗下方一行小字「{callout_3}」，界面节点用 {accent_color} 圆点

shots.intent: 三张编号细节卡逐点交代做工，替买家把该看的地方看完。
shots.textZone: 顶部衬线标题「{selling_point_4}」；三张卡片底缘色条上的编号小字「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」

shots.intent: 尺寸与规格信息图，把孔距、把手长和门厚适配问题一次说清。
shots.textZone: 尺寸线数值以占位符呈现：「{callout_1}」「{callout_2}」「{callout_3}」；下方四行规格表，行名为通用词，数值为「{callout_4}」；衬线标题「{selling_point_5}」

shots.intent: 俯视摊开随货可见的全部零件，用实物完整性收口打消下单顾虑。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行衬线标题「{selling_point_6}」，其下一行细无衬线小字「{callout_1}」

style.backgroundSystem: only two fields: a low-key charcoal studio built from stacked matte fine-grain stone plinths, and a paper-white infographic field carrying one slate-painted flush door panel; no other environment anywhere in the set
style.direction: premium minimalist hardware ecommerce, dark editorial opening plus clean paper-white infographic screens
style.iconSystem: hairline single-weight outline icons and rounded pill labels hung on 1px leader lines, drawn in #2A2A2C on light fields and #F7F5F1 on dark fields, accents in {accent_color}
style.lightingSystem: metal is always lit by a hard raking side key from camera left that pulls one long specular band along the plating, with a wide soft bounce on the shadow side; dark screens fall off into #1A1A1C, infographic screens run even and near-shadowless; 5000-5600K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium minimalist hardware-ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of low-key charcoal #1A1A1C, paper-warm off-white #F7F5F1, slate blue-grey #5B6A80 for the door panel and label bars, and one accent colour injected as {accent_color}; cool neutral grade; one high-contrast serif display face for headlines plus one light geometric sans-serif for body, labels and numbers, never a third face; backgrounds limited to a stacked matte-stone plinth studio and a clean paper-white infographic field; lighting always a hard raking side key from camera left that pulls one long specular band along the plated metal, with a wide soft bounce on the shadow side and a 5000-5600K colour temperature; hairline outline icons and rounded pill labels on 1px leader lines; stable product scale and centring across every screen, metal rendered with true anodized reflectance and never a plastic sheen; every piece grounded by a visible contact shadow; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks, no QR codes, no coupons, no invented specs.
noDrift: no mixed fonts beyond the one serif display plus one geometric sans
no inconsistent lighting direction or shadow strength
no mismatched icon or label styles
no invented measurement numbers, certifications, awards or lab data
no plastic sheen on metal and no product floating without a contact shadow

palette.name: 石板蓝灰门板与标签条

style.presentationRules: the handle keeps one proportional scale across all screens; the rose stays circular and the spindle axis stays level unless an angle demands otherwise; light rakes from camera left in every shot; plating must read as true anodized metal, never as plastic; no brand mark, wordmark, QR code, coupon, price or review copy may appear
style.surfaceSystem: matte fine-grain stone blocks, cast-plaster wall, painted flush door panel, matte paper-white card fields; every object stands on a real contact shadow
style.typography: one high-contrast serif display face for headlines plus one light geometric sans-serif for body, labels and numbers; two faces only, no handwritten or cartoon lettering, rendered copy always in short Chinese callouts wrapped in 「」
